# Design — POST /v1/loans/{id}/disburse logging discipline

## L1 invariant

Observability output MUST be structured (machine-indexable). Format-string interpolation in `tracing` macros is forbidden; use structured fields. Metric labels MUST have bounded cardinality; user-scoped identifiers (user_id, account_id, request_id, IP, email) are FORBIDDEN as label values.

## Public contract

- Route: `POST /v1/loans/:id/disburse`
- Telemetry: span `loan.disburse` with bounded fields (`loan_id` allowed only as a span field, not a metric label).
- Metrics: `loan_disbursements_total{currency, status_class}`. Currency is bounded enum; status_class is `success|client|server|dependency`.

## Convention notes

- Logging crate: `tracing`.
- Use `field = %value` (Display) or `field = ?value` (Debug) sigils.
- Format-string log lines (`tracing::info!("...{}...", x)`) are a finding regardless of severity.
